name: rebind attr
code:
class B:
    pass
b = B()
b.v = [1]
x = b.v
b.v = [9]
print(x, b.v)

name: rebind int attr
code:
class B:
    pass
b = B()
b.v = 1
x = b.v
b.v = 2
print(x, b.v)

name: attr index write
code:
class B:
    pass
b = B()
b.v = [1, 2]
x = b.v
b.v[0] = 9
print(x, b.v)

name: attr nested list
code:
class B:
    def __init__(self):
        self.v = []
b = B()
x = b.v
x.append(1)
print(x, b.v)
b.v.append(2)
print(x, b.v)
